reason: The README clearly describes a DSH Web plugin that summarizes newly generated reasoning in Chinese and displays plans and summary cards to help users follow model work.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中将新生成的模型思考内容总结为中文计划和摘要卡片，帮助用户理解模型的工作过程。
summaries.en: Summarizes newly generated model reasoning in Chinese and displays plans and summary cards in DSH Web to help users follow the model’s work.

capabilities: Reads newly generated reasoning text from session and event logs
Sends reasoning text to deepseek-v4-flash for summarization
Displays plans and summaries in the DSH web interface
